Maya Patel: Hey team — I addressed the review comments and pushed a squash. PTAL when you have a minute. There's one tiny logging nit I left a question on. Also FYI this needs a canary slot to merge (see infra queue).
Samir Gupta: Looking now. quick question — did you keep the retrybackoff change?
Maya Patel: yes kept it, just tightened the max backoff. pushed.
Elaine Chen: scanning... saw the logging nit, prefer `info` over `debug` for that path. tiny.
Maya Patel: good call, changed to `info` and pushed. thanks.
Samir Gupta: ci-bot, any CI results?
ci-bot: build #4821 — checks passed: unit, lint, integration. :white_check_mark:
Maya Patel: awesome, thanks. I'm re-requesting review: PTAL @Samir @Elaine — after smoke we can merge.
Samir Gupta: quick smoke run locally now. paste of smoke commands in case anyone else needs:
```
# quick smoke
pytest tests/smoke/test_canary.py::test_basic_flow -q
./scripts/smoke-run --env=canary --quick
```
Mike H: FYI infra queue shows one canary ahead; ETA ~1h30. We can bump priority but that'll delay another team's rollout.
Maya Patel: hmm. Are we okay waiting or should we do manual fallback merge and hold rollout?
Samir Gupta: prefer wait for canary — want the smoke to run in canary. I'll hold my approval until smoke passes.
Elaine Chen: same, small change but want to see canary smoke.
Maya Patel: ok will wait. re-requesting review again so you're notified. PTAL when slot opens :pray:
Samir Gupta: noted, ping me again when canary smoke completes and I'll give LGTM.
Maya Patel: will do. Thanks all.
